## Change and reason

Describe the infrastructure behavior and operational reason.

## Review

- [ ] Validation and mocked Terraform tests pass.
- [ ] Security, cost, replacement and data-loss implications reviewed.
- [ ] Runbooks updated where behavior changes.
- [ ] Migration/rollback steps documented for stateful changes.
- [ ] Production plan will be reviewed in the deployment log after merge.

## Validation and rollback

Record checks, expected resource changes, and recovery steps.
